'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]] 
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least fifteen people are killed in an [[Israel]]i attack on a school sheltering [[displaced people]] in the [[Sheikh Radwan]] neighbourhood of [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/3/israeli-attack-on-school-in-gaza-kills-at-least-15-people (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Hezbollah–Israel conflict|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**One killed and six were injured in Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon.[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/3/israels-war-on-gaza-live-us-sends-ships-jets-to-region-as-tension-soars/ (Al Jazeera)] 
**Hezbollah launches rockets at [[Upper Galilee]] in northern Israel which are intercepted by Israel's [[Iron Dome]] and misses an Israeli airforce plane in Lebanese airspace.[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/3/israels-war-on-gaza-live-us-sends-ships-jets-to-region-as-tension-soars/ (Al Jazeera)] 
**The [[Embassy of the United States, Beirut|United States embassy in Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], urges its citizens to leave the country amid increasing tensions in the [[Middle East]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c80xxeqel5po (BBC News)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Niger]]
**The [[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] takes two [[Russia]]n citizens hostage in Mbanga, [[Niger]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-qaeda-affiliate-says-it-has-taken-two-russians-hostage-niger-2024-08-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Economic impact of the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[S&P Global Ratings|S&P Global]] downgrades [[Ukraine]]'s [[credit rating]] to "SD" for 'selective' [[Default (finance)|default]] after Ukraine was unable to pay a [[US$]]34 million [[Bond (finance)|international bond]] payment, and also stating that Ukraine's credit rating could fall to "D", which would represent a complete default following restructuring of Ukraine's debt. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/sp-cuts-ukraine-rating-selective-default-restructuring-looms-2024-08-03/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Antarctica heat wave]]
**A record prolonged [[heat wave]] persists over [[Antarctica]], with temperatures reaching {{conv|50|F-change}} higher than average in some areas during the middle of [[winter]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/03/climate/antarctica-heat-wave-sea-level-rise/index.html (CNN)] 
*[[2024 Japan heatwaves]]
**The [[Japan Meteorological Agency|Japanese Meteorological Agency]] issues excessive heat warnings for 37 of the 47 [[prefectures of Japan|prefectures]] amid [[heat wave]]s where at least 59 people have died from [[heat stroke]] since April. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20240803_05/ (NHK)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/2/japan-swelters-through-hottest-july-in-recorded-history (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Parole for Cubans, Haitians, Nicaraguans, and Venezuelans]]
**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] provisionally suspends all [[Parole (United States immigration)|migrant permits]] allowing [[Venezuelans]], [[Cubans]], [[Haitians]], and [[Nicaraguans]] to enter and stay in the [[United States]] for up to two years following suspicions of [[fraud]] by several migrant financial sponsors. [https://apnews.com/article/cnhv-cubans-haitians-nicaraguans-venezuelans-parole-border-8440fe7e468dc985fb8939ccaa1be8e8 (AP)]
*The [[Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam]] elects [[President of Vietnam|President]] [[Tô Lâm]] as the new [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam|General Secretary]] of the [[Communist Party of Vietnam]], succeeding [[Nguyễn Phú Trọng]], who died on July 19. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/vietnam-president-lam-communist-party-chief-nguyen-phu-trong-4524261 (CNA)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Dominica at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Thea LaFond]] wins the gold medal in the [[Athletics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's triple jump|Women's triple jump]], earning [[Dominica]] its [[Dominica at the Olympics|first ever]] Olympic medal. [https://www.barrons.com/news/dominica-s-lafond-wins-olympic-women-s-triple-jump-gold-e56064e1 (Barron's)]
**[[Philippines at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Carlos Yulo]] wins the gold medal in [[Gymnastics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's floor|Men's floor gymnastics]], the [[Philippines]]' first medal in [[Gymnastics at the Olympics|the sport]] and the country's [[Philippines at the Olympics|second ever]] gold medal. [https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/40715563/carlos-yulo-wins-gold-become-philippines-second-olympic-champion (ESPN)]
**[[Saint Lucia at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Julien Alfred]] wins the gold medal in the [[Athletics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's 100 metres|Women's 100 metres]], earning [[Saint Lucia]] its [[Saint Lucia at the Olympics|first ever]] Olympic medal. [https://www.barrons.com/news/st-lucia-s-alfred-wins-olympic-women-s-100m-gold-474f82f4 (Barron's)]
**[[United States at the 2024 Summer Olympics]], [[Swimming at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***American swimmer [[Katie Ledecky]] wins her ninth gold medal, tying with [[Soviet]] [[artistic gymnastics|artistic gymnast]] [[Larisa Latynina]]'s [[List of multiple Olympic medalists|record]] of most gold medals by a female Olympian. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/olympics/swimming-ledecky-wins-record-equalling-ninth-gold-medal-2024-08-03/ (Reuters)]
